prompt.title: Online learning for school students
prompt.text:
Some people believe that school students learn better online than in a traditional classroom. Others think face-to-face lessons are more effective.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Use reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

You should write at least 250 words.

essay:
Nowaday, many student study online. Some people think it is good, other people think it is not good.

First, online study is very convenient. Student can study at home and they dont need go to school. They can save time and money for bus. Also they can watch the video again if they dont understand. My cousin study english online and he say it is very easy for him.

But, study online have many problem. Student is very easy to play game or use facebook when teacher dont see them. They also feel lonely because they cannot meet friend. Some family dont have good internet or computer, so the children cannot study good. When I study online in covid, I am very tired and my eye is hurt.

In other hand, study in class is better for talk with teacher. If student have question, teacher can answer immediately. Student can play with friend and learn how to work in group. Teacher also can check student do homework or not.

In my opinion, I think study in class is better than study online because student learn more and they are happy. But online study is also good for some subject. The goverment should help poor family to buy computer.

In conclusion, both way have advantage and disadvantage. I think student should study in class but they can use online for more practice.
